text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stopping by the shopping district after afternoon training
to buy equipment...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. What is that?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, huh. Come to think of it,
I received a ticket earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's no point if you don't use it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hand over the tickets already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
According to Sis, spinning the raffle wheel
is my job. Just sit back and watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand the ticket over to a strangely
confident Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Narita Brian courageously spun the lever
of the raffle machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oho... The grand prize, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're way too excited.
You're acting just like a proud big sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Every time the wheel was spun and a prize was drawn,
they clapped both hands together repeatedly to welcome it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, enough reminiscing.
Here, you can have the prize."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean, 'why'?
You're the one who owned the ticket in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I merely drew the raffle ticket.
The right to claim the prize belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*. What an overly serious fellow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then when the time comes, I shall use it whenever
I see fit. You have no objections to that, do you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the hot spring trip voucher
was handed over to Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Another delicious-looking prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, you've got a sharp eye! Truth is,
the price of this hamburg steak is... *whisper whisper*

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What?! Impossible!
Such a luxury item as a mere lottery prize?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I recommend eating it right away.
Freshness is the most important thing for any food!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back quickly, Trainer.
And prepare the rice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The lottery isn't over until I devour this meat...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking alongside Narita Brian, who was pacing much faster than usual, we headed back to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, did I hit the mark?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Well aren't you something, missy!
Winning 2nd prize!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Stop that. Don't praise me
over something like this. It's embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I told you to quit it. Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared the prize carrots with Narita Brian,
who seemed just a little bit shy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Third prize, huh.
choice_data_list: Still, we're lucky to have won anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's just how the lottery goes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the prize was a carrot.
At least it's a vegetable I can actually eat, so I got lucky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she disliked vegetables, carrots were apparently an exception.
I ended up giving the prize to her.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......A miss, huh.
choice_data_list: There are times like this too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, a lottery without losing tickets is pretty boring anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It is all down to fate. It's precisely because you never know what will pop out when you give it a spin that makes it so fun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Though naturally, hitting the jackpot would've been better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while, Narita Brian's tail remained completely droopy...
